Lessons.Title: Same Size, Related Sizes
ExplanationParagraphs: Original Grade4 Unit2 Lesson4 2021 Student Task Statements 3-page source. The source title is Same Size, Related Sizes, without the erroneous PLC Activity suffix; same original goal and standard retained.
Warm-up: notice and wonder about source fraction strip aligned with a number line; locate0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1 and discuss correspondence.

Activity1: source strip chart has two blanks for TENTHS and TWELFTHS. Partition/label them in10 and12 equal parts, justify Jada's1/2=2/4=3/6 statement, and find equivalents for1/6 (2/12),2/10 (1/5),3/3 (1). Teacher checks the drawings.

Activity2: FOUR original number lines, label tick marks; locate1/6,1/8,1/10 on different compatible lines. Locate all further ten source targets2/3,2/8,2/5,3/5,4/6,4/8,4/10,6/6,6/10,8/8. Discuss same points for equivalent values and preserve whole-size endpoints0..1.
Lesson synthesis: matching-size fractions can have unlike numerator/denominator names; number-line points are distances from0, not positions between ticks.
First-party Edulytics 5-minute Cool-down (NOT publisher-original gated task): show1/2=2/4=3/6 on one aligned line and1/5=2/10, explaining why. Teacher reviews explanations and original line drawing.

KeyConcepts.Title: Equivalent fractions
KeyConcepts.Definition: Same value relative to equal-size wholes.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Multiply both numerator and denominator by same positive whole factor.

KeyConcepts.Title: Related denominators
KeyConcepts.Rule: Bisect fifths to obtain tenths and sixths to obtain twelfths.

KeyConcepts.Title: Number-line placement
KeyConcepts.Definition: A fraction corresponds to distance from0 in same unit0..1.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Place the label AT a tick at exact value.

WorkedExamples.Title: Place on line
WorkedExamples.Question: Where does4/8 belong on0–1 number line?

CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: Source fraction marks are points on line.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Label at correct tick distance from0.

CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: Same size equivalences require same whole.
